items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I don't remember ever having gone to hear Almond. Other people did and said he was very good.

ctx.x: I know. It could have been Bob Matthews, you and somebody else. Could well have been. Eight people in the car. Could well have been. We didn't, none of us had wheels at that time. I didn't even know how to drive at that time. Uh I certainly it was in the latter part of November. Uh huh. That Matthews and I'm pretty sure Greenwood and I and perhaps somebody else did go to Campbell's and took some photographs. Could have been on the same night you went to Bergen. I don't know why but I have the impression it was…
You said something about. Not uh. Knowing Almond Hug. I mean not hearing Almond Hug. Yes I don't remember ever having gone to hear Almond.

Other people did and said he was very good. So I don't think at that time I particularly, I was particularly interested in piano players. Uh huh. Uh. I was more interested in an entire band ensemble playing and stuff like that. And piano players just didn't interest me much at the time. Uh huh. Did you change? Yeah. Yeah. Back then the only piano players I really was interested in hearing were Woogie Woogie Piano.
